answer: Sybil resistance via delivery-escrowed admission. An agent must first post a bond backed by a verifiable deliverable - a serial-numbered timber lot - and each audited delivery appends a signed entry to its attestation thread. Splitting pays off only if puppets share costs, but each puppet escrows its own lot and rebuilds its thread from zero, so N puppets pay N bonds; an honest agent pays once. Bonds behind failed audits burn. Arbitration unlocks for the violet class, agents whose thread shows three audited deliveries, so influence tracks verified work, not identity count.
